title: 第三章 什么情况？
content_zh: 钱三江沉思着，怎么跟教主汇报。“教主这血灵七剑，这小子明显是入了门了，杀伤力也足够，这么短的时间就做到这一点，如果教主知道，应该会很欣慰……”钱三江在想着如何利用方彻这点，帮自己拍个响亮的马屁。职场嘛，要恰饭，不寒碜。毕竟供奉不少呢。……方彻坐在马车上，闭目养神。心中却在衡量，这几个‘偶然’驻足此地，观看纷争的武生们。‘魏子豪是嫌疑最大的，但是，不应该只有他自己。另外隔得很远，看起来有些瘦弱的那个青子悦，也有些嫌疑。’‘但现在不想动他们，一来无用，二来距离他们家族太近，容易给自家引来麻烦；三来留着他们，到了武院可以随时找麻烦，尤其是想要制造动静，传递消息的时候，随时都能用得着他们，天然挡箭牌……’‘这些都可以作为后手。现在动他们太浪费资源了。’‘对于这种能随时虐的资源，一定要珍惜。’方彻闭着眼睛坐在车上，脸上一片平静。心中却在寻思。‘我这一趟出来，接着就要进入武院，一进去也不知道啥时候能出来，哎，前世也没上过武院……不知道规矩。’‘我身边有个夜梦在跟着，而且，在暗中，应该还有人在看着我。不管是镇守大殿，还是一心教，都不会放我离开视线。’‘但是此去，终有一些不便，也不知道金角蛟现在修炼怎么样了？本想将它带上的，也不知道有没有机会。’方彻目光沉思着，看着远方。那是百瘴峰的方向。本身就属于万灵之森的外围。距离现在自己待的地方，并不是很远。只有五百多里。‘但是若是金角蛟并没有修炼到无形的地步，戴在身上，用处不大。甚至还有离开极阴之地消散的风险。’方彻最终还是放弃了这个打算。那边有极阴之地，让金角蛟多修炼一段时间吧。宁可让它多等几個月，甚至一年两年，也胜似现在过去万一还没修炼完成就暴露或者消散的好的多！方彻轻轻吐了一口气，不再想这件事。金角蛟，是他为自己早早准备的一个后手。在夜梦没出现的时候，方彻就一直在考虑这一步暗棋。因为作为一个魂体，传递消息，实在是太方便了。就连上次设计苏家人，虽然是个意外，但是其中也有将那些家伙送去给金角蛟补身子的想法。他一直在等，等金角蛟化有形为无形，魂体修为再进一步，便会接到身边来。哪怕现在有了夜梦，他也没有放弃这个打算。但一直到现在，这个一直蠢蠢欲动的计划，还是只能暂时搁置。‘步步为营可以影响长远的计划，绝不能因为方便好用就提前动！’……终于，已经到了万灵之森。车夫已经返回，作为只是有点武力的普通人，行车到这里，就已经是极限。而方彻到现在才提出来：我把你这马车买下来，你自己回去。方彻出了两倍的价钱。车夫很是痛快的同意了。只是很不解：你要买，为何不早买？非要到了现在才买？方彻当然不会早买，他在车厢里一边舒服的坐着休息，一边还要梳理思路；虽然思路早就理清楚了，但是……多享受一会是一会儿。因为车夫走了之后只能自己赶车！夜梦只能坐车。——接下来的事情，都要自己独立完成才算是成绩。但是少爷赶车丫鬟坐车这种事，方彻有些心里不平衡，所以坚持坐了一半的路。“进去坐着！”方彻黑着脸：“本少爷亲自赶车。”“啊？”夜梦都懵了。圆圆的大眼睛懵逼的看着方彻。太阳从西边出来了，突然又开始体贴了？难道是终于意识到了本姑娘的无双美貌？“出了万灵之森，你要是还没进步，我就把你卖入青楼！”方彻恐吓一句，随即拿起马鞭：“驾！”夜梦：…………夜梦在马车里盘腿坐着等待。大眼睛不断的翻起来，俏脸上，一脸无语。因为方彻将她和马车都扔在了森林里，自己去猎杀妖兽去了。“咋就能这么放心呢？我这么娇滴滴的美女就这么扔在森林里，而且表面上看来只有武徒三品修为，不怕回来的时候已经变成了一堆被啃剩下的骨头？”“真是一点也不怜香惜玉。”“这心也忒大了！”虽然心中抱怨，但是脸上却还要做出来一脸惊恐不安的样子，蜷缩在马车里，一动也不敢动。心中只是在祈祷。千万别有猛兽过来。要不然真的会暴露。……方彻如同幽灵一般，在密林中穿行，所过之处，甚至带不起半点树叶响动。他的目标，便是森林中的妖兽。六级之下妖兽！一级妖兽，一百个内核，一个学院积分，二级，五十个内核，一个积分，三级十个内核一个积分，四级两个内核一个积分，五级，一个内核两个积分，六级，一个内核，二十个积分。但是六级妖兽，基本相当于武师五品左右的战力了。至于七级……咳，不想。一旦出现自己就要做好成为粪便的准备了。方彻的目标，根本不是一级二级三级。那太慢了。所以他一开始，就直奔丛林深处。对于丛林中被惊起来的一二级妖兽，根本不屑一顾。但越是深入，方彻越是感觉有什么地方不对。但却又说不上来。在一片茂密的灌木前，浓密的草丛里，方彻终于蓦然停下脚步。看着灌木，看着草丛，看着周围的树木，那种‘有些不对’的感觉越发的浓重。但是究竟哪里不对，却说不上来。不由沉思起来。有感觉，就必定有情况。但这情况在哪里？他凝神思索，一棵草一棵灌木一棵树的看过去。不对劲的地方就在环境上，但是环境的不对在哪里？看了许久，他脑子里灵光闪了一下，蓦然想起来，劫道的那两人。因为那俩人的原因，方彻格外的注意了一下环境。当时那两人站立在粗大的树木下面，树叶闪光，叶片肥厚。再看面前，灌木生长虽然旺盛，但是不管是树木还是草丛，叶片都很薄，不至于营养不良吧，却也不能说营养丰富。灌木很细，但树皮斑驳，看得出年岁很久。
content_en: Qian Sanjiang pondered how to report to the leader."The leader of the Seven Swords of the Blood Spirit, this kid has obviously mastered it, and his lethality is enough. He can do this in such a short time. If the leader knew, he would be very pleased..." Qian Sanjiang was thinking about how to use Fang Che's point to flatter himself loudly.In the workplace, you need to be well-fed and not shabby.After all, there are a lot of offerings....Fang Che sat in the carriage, closing his eyes to relax.But in his heart, he was weighing the few military students who stopped here by chance to watch the dispute.‘Wei Zihao is the biggest suspect, but he shouldn’t be the only one.In addition, Qing Ziyue, who was far away and looked a little thin, was also a little suspicious.’ ‘But I don’t want to touch them now. Firstly, it is useless. Secondly, they are too close to their family and may easily cause trouble to themselves. Thirdly, keep them so that they can cause trouble at any time when they arrive at the martial arts academy. Especially when you want to make noise and convey news, you can use them at any time as a natural shield...’ ‘These can all be used as back-up tools.It would be a waste of resources to move them now.’ ‘We must cherish this kind of resource that can be abused at any time.’ Fang Che sat in the car with his eyes closed, his face calm.But I was thinking in my heart.‘When I come out this time, I will enter the martial arts academy. Once I enter, I don’t know when I will be able to come out. Hey, I have never been to a martial arts academy in my previous life... I don’t know the rules.’ ‘There is a night dream following me, and there should be someone watching me in the dark.No matter who is guarding the main hall or teaching Yixin, they will never let me out of sight.’ ‘But there will be some inconvenience after all. I don’t know how the Golden Horned Jiao is doing with his cultivation now?I wanted to take it with me, but I didn’t know if I would have the chance.’ Fang Che looked thoughtfully into the distance.That is the direction of Bai Mi Peak.It itself belongs to the periphery of the Forest of All Souls.It's not very far from where I am now.Only more than five hundred miles.'But if the Golden Horned Jiao has not been cultivated to the point of becoming invisible, wearing it on the body will not be of much use.There is even a risk of leaving the extremely dark place and dissipating.’ Fang Che finally gave up this plan.There is a very dark place over there. Let the Golden Horned Jiao practice for a while.It would be better to let it wait for a few more months, or even a year or two, than to have it exposed or dissipate before the cultivation is completed!Fang Che let out a breath and stopped thinking about it.The golden-horned dragon was a backup plan he had prepared for himself.When Ye Meng didn't appear, Fang Che had been thinking about this secret move.Because as a soul, it is really convenient to deliver messages.Even though the design of the Su family last time was an accident, there was also the idea of ​​sending those guys to the Golden Horned Jiao to replenish their health.He has been waiting, waiting for the Golden Horned Jiao to transform from tangible to intangible, and when his soul and body have improved further, he will receive it.Even though he has Ye Meng now, he has not given up on this plan.But until now, this plan that has been looming has been temporarily shelved.‘Working step by step can affect your long-term plan. Never act in advance just because it is convenient and easy to use!’...Finally, we have arrived at the Forest of All Spirits.The driver has returned. As an ordinary person with only a little bit of strength, driving to this point is already the limit.But Fang Che only proposed it now: I will buy your carriage and you can go back by yourself.Fang Che offered twice the price.The coachman readily agreed.I just don’t understand: If you want to buy it, why didn’t you buy it earlier?Do you have to buy it now?Of course Fang Che would not buy it early. He sat and rested comfortably in the carriage while sorting out his thoughts. Although his thoughts had been sorted out long ago,... he would enjoy it for a while longer.Because after the driver left, I had to drive the car by myself!Yemeng can only take a car.——The next things must be completed independently to be considered an achievement.But Fang Che felt a little unbalanced when the young master drove the car and the maid took the car, so he insisted on sitting for half of the way."Go in and sit down!" Fang Che said with a dark face, "I will drive the car myself." "Huh?" Ye Meng was confused.His big round eyes looked at Fang Che blankly.The sun comes out from the west, and suddenly I feel considerate again?Could it be that he finally realized this girl's unparalleled beauty?"After leaving the Forest of All Souls, if you don't make progress, I will sell you into a brothel!" Fang Che threatened, then picked up the riding whip: "Drive!" Ye Meng: ... Ye Meng sat cross-legged in the carriage and waited.Her big eyes kept rolling up, and her pretty face was speechless.Because Fang Che left her and the carriage in the forest and went to hunt monsters by himself."How can you be so relieved? A beautiful woman like me is just left in the forest, and on the surface, she only has a third-level martial arts training. Aren't you afraid that she will be turned into a pile of chewed bones when she comes back?" "You really don't show mercy at all." "This is too big of a heart!" Although he complained in his heart, he still had to look frightened and uneasy on his face. He huddled in the carriage, not daring to move.I just pray in my heart.Don't let any wild beasts come over.Otherwise it will really be exposed.... Fang Che was like a ghost, walking through the dense forest, not even making the slightest sound of leaves wherever he passed.His target is the monster in the forest.A monster below level six!A level one monster requires one hundred cores and one college point; level two requires fifty cores and one point; level three has ten cores and one point; level four has two cores and one point; level five has one core and two points; level six has one core and twenty points.But the sixth-level monster is basically equivalent to the combat power of a fifth-level martial artist.As for level seven...well, I don’t want to.Once you emerge, be prepared to become excrement.Fang Che's goal is not level one, two, or three at all.That's too slow.So as soon as he started, he went straight into the depths of the jungle.He didn't even care about the first and second level monsters that were startled in the jungle.But the deeper he went, the more Fang Che felt that something was wrong.But I can't tell.In front of a dense bush, Fang Che finally stopped suddenly in the thick grass.Looking at the bushes, the grass, and the surrounding trees, the feeling that something was wrong became stronger and stronger.But what exactly is wrong, I can't say.He couldn't help but think deeply.If there is a feeling, there must be a situation.But where is the situation?He concentrated on thinking, looking at the grass, shrubs and trees.What is wrong is the environment, but what is wrong with the environment?look
